claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi_mode_ongoing
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Thoughts activates one of two effects on cast and allows re-selection each subsequent turn via Magic action. The current ongoing_effect family has a single operation field; there is no mechanism for player-choice between N operations per activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: sense_presence
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Sense Thoughts mode grants awareness of nearby thinking creatures — a detection/informational effect. No existing v4 effect atom covers presence-sensing. The current Effect union is DamageEffect | NoneEffect; grant_sense in v4 covers sensory modes (darkvision, etc.) not active proximity detection of creature mental states.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_information
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Read Thoughts mode's save-gate fail branch grants informational content (surface thoughts, then on probe: reasoning/emotions). No v4 effect atom covers information disclosure as a mechanical outcome. The save gate exists but its onFail result must be expressible as a typed Effect — currently only damage or none.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. [...] you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_check_counter (target-initiated)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The target can spend their action to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against the caster's spell save DC to end the spell. This is a target-initiated ability_check resolution that terminates the caster's ongoing concentration effect — no existing resolution atom or relation covers this contested-check termination pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.
